lines.text: Patients now call the front desk to book, and the lines are busy most mornings.
Most patients will use the app on their phones.
- Patients shall book an appointment with any doctor who has a free slot.
- Each appointment slot shall be 15 minutes long.
- Patients can cancel an appointment up to 2 hours before it starts.
- The system must send an SMS reminder 24 hours before the appointment.
- A patient may cancel an appointment up to 6 hours before it starts.
- Doctors shall see their schedule for the next 7 days.
- Doctors are able to block slots when they are on leave.
- For senior doctors, each appointment slot shall be 20 minutes long.
- Patient records must be encrypted at rest.
- The booking page should load quickly on slow networks.
- The app shall follow the national health data rules.
- The system shall be available 99.9% of the time.
